title: 城市晨光
theme: 一名年轻咖啡师在城市中的清晨旅程：从家中出发、穿过街道、抵达咖啡店开始一天的工作。
theme_en: A young barista's morning journey through the city: leaving home, walking through streets, arriving at the coffee shop to start the workday.
style: 电影感，暖色调，自然光，轻快节奏
style_en: Cinematic, warm tones, natural light, light-paced
required_subject: 同一名咖啡师角色，穿白色围裙，出现在至少3个镜头中
required_subject_en: Same barista character, wearing white apron, appearing in at least 3 shots

scenes.description: 室内，清晨，角色从床上醒来，拉开窗帘
scenes.description_en: Interior, early morning, character wakes up and opens curtains

scenes.description: 城市街道，角色穿过晨光中的街道走向咖啡店
scenes.description_en: City street, character walks through morning light toward the coffee shop

scenes.description: 咖啡店内，角色系上围裙开始准备咖啡
scenes.description_en: Inside coffee shop, character puts on apron and starts preparing coffee
